experiment: Phase 4: periodic versus fixed-budget adaptive replay
scope: Exploratory Split-MNIST pilot. Adaptive methods have a maximum of 43 one-step replay bursts; trigger thresholds are prespecified pilot settings, not development-tuned or final results.

configuration.trigger_order: signal checked pre-update; EMA updated after loss signal; incoming update then replay burst
configuration.probe_policy: fixed 32-example sample from initial reservoir, reserved inside total 500-example memory
